name: reindex
description: Trigger full re-index of a project. REQUIRED: workspace_dir must be specified. First-time index takes ~3 minutes per 1000 files (tree-sitter parsing). Subsequent calls are fast if nothing changed. This is required before using other malong tools (symbol_search, references, impact_analysis, dep_graph).

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory to index. This is the directory that will be scanned and indexed for symbol search, references, etc.
